teaser.en: Named for laying the spirits of the dead to rest in peace.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina kwa kuzilaza roho za wafu zipumzike kwa amani.

summary.en: Mlazakoma is a slender twining climber of the milkweed group. Its name records its use in appeasing the spirits of dead relatives.
summary.sw: Mlazakoma ni mmea mwembamba unaojizungusha na kupanda juu ya mingine, wa kundi la *milkweed*. Jina lake linahifadhi matumizi yake katika kutuliza roho za ndugu waliokufa.

about.en: *Mlazakoma* is a slender twining climber in the milkweed group of the dogbane family. Plants of this group have milky sap, opposite leaves, and small star-shaped flowers, and their seeds are carried on tufts of silky hairs.
about.sw: *Mlazakoma* ni mmea mwembamba unaopanda kwa kujizungusha, katika kundi la *milkweed* la familia ya Apocynaceae. Mimea ya kundi hili ina utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, na mbegu zake hupeperushwa na vishungi vya nywele laini kama hariri.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket in eastern Africa.
where.sw: Unaota katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani mashariki mwa Afrika.

culture.en: Pakia records that the plant is used to appease the *koma*, the spirits of dead relatives, and to put them to sleep (*laza*) in peace. The *koma* are an important part of Digo belief about the dead.
culture.sw: Pakia anaandika kwamba mmea huu hutumika kutuliza *koma*, yaani roho za ndugu waliokufa, na kuzilaza (*laza*) kwa amani. *Koma* ni sehemu muhimu ya imani ya Wadigo kuhusu wafu.

names.en: *Mlaza koma* means 'layer of spirits', the one that lays the spirits (*koma*) of dead relatives to rest (*laza*). Pakia spells it both as one word and as two. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mlaza koma* maana yake ni 'mlaza roho', yule anayezilaza roho (*koma*) za ndugu waliokufa (*laza*) zipumzike. Pakia analiandika kama neno moja na pia kama maneno mawili. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.

reason.en: Also named for a magical use (whips against enemies)
reason.sw: Nao umepewa jina kwa matumizi ya kiuchawi (mijeledi dhidi ya maadui)

reason.en: Parquetina, a climber of the same family
reason.sw: Parquetina, mmea unaopanda wa familia ileile
Tylophora, mmea unaopanda wa kundi la milkweed
